titleText.es: Hablaba sobre una copa y una espada y un árbol y una colina verde...
titleText.en: There was something about a cup and a sword and a tree and a green hill ...
titleText.noteEn: The comic image has no dialogue or captions. Its only printed unit is a three-exclamation surprise mark.

regions.geometryRationale: OCR mistook distant dream scenery for text and omitted the actual punctuation; this measured box tightly covers the three visible exclamation marks above the waking figure.

excludedUnits.rationale: These exclamation marks visually signal surprise but are punctuation, not Spanish lexical material.
excludedUnits.geometryRationale: OCR omitted these punctuation marks entirely; this measured box follows only the three printed marks and stops above the character's head.
